settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Iwo Jima February 1945, U.S. Marine composite soldier POV, black volcanic sand, landing craft, smoke, steep terrain, cave and pillbox positions at distance, authentic Pacific uniforms and gear, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite U.S. Marine POV during the Iwo Jima landings and early advance. One main action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration and no intelligible human speech. Audio uses breathing, nonverbal exertion, surf, wind, volcanic sand, equipment, engines and distant battlefield effects only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Pacific island warfare reenactment, black volcanic sand, humid haze, smoke, restrained handheld camera, non-graphic.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP05 — Iwo Jima: Black Sand Landing
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. Marine experiences the opening days of the Iwo Jima battle, from the landing craft and black volcanic beach to the inland push and a later glimpse of the flag on Mount Suribachi, ending with the reminder that the battle is still far from over.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite U.S. Marine during the Iwo Jima landings beginning 19 February 1945. Show black volcanic sand, difficult movement, beach congestion, inland advance, airfield terrain, night defense and a later distant view of Mount Suribachi. Tell everything visually with no spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Approaching the Island
scenes.description: POV inside a landing craft as Iwo Jima emerges through haze.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks over the landing craft side toward the island.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. Marine POV from landing craft toward hazy volcanic Iwo Jima, Mount Suribachi visible in distance, gray sea, period gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from inside craft toward island. Audio: engine, waves, distant naval gunfire, gear vibration, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Ramp to Black Sand
scenes.description: The craft reaches shore and the ramp drops.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV steps off the ramp onto black volcanic sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over landing craft ramp onto Iwo Jima black sand beach, Marines moving inland through smoke, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Ramp drops once and camera moves forward onto sand. Audio: ramp crash, surf, distant artillery, boots, heavy breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Sand Gives Way
scenes.description: The soldier struggles to climb the loose volcanic terrace.
scenes.actionDescription: Boots sink into loose black ash while the POV pushes uphill.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person downward view of boots sinking into coarse black volcanic sand, rifle and gloved hands visible, Marines climbing ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low first-person struggle uphill with unstable footing. Audio: heavy breathing, sand sliding, equipment bounce, distant combat. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Beach Cover
scenes.description: The POV drops behind a low sand ridge as smoke crosses the beach.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier crouches briefly behind one volcanic ridge and looks inland.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low cover behind black sand ridge, smoke drifting, Marines moving inland, landing craft behind, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops low then tilts once inland. Audio: surf, distant shelling, ash movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Push Inland
scenes.description: The squad leaves the beach and moves toward the first inland positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows two Marines along a marked route inland.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person movement across dark volcanic ground with sparse vegetation, Marines ahead, smoke and beach behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward tracking along one route. Audio: boots on ash, wind, distant fire, equipment movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Airfield Edge
scenes.description: The soldier reaches rough ground near Airfield No. 1.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV pauses behind a shallow berm and scans the airfield edge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle over rough berm looking toward wartime airfield ground, churned volcanic soil, smoke, no visible close enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow horizontal scan across airfield edge. Audio: wind, distant bursts, loose gravel, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Across the Open Ground
scenes.description: The squad makes a short move across exposed terrain.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV runs once from berm to a crater edge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint across dark volcanic airfield terrain toward shallow crater, squadmates ahead, smoke in distance.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single fast forward run ending at crater cover. Audio: boots, equipment bounce, heavy breathing, distant gunfire. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Crater Position
scenes.description: The soldier settles briefly in a crater with the squad.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV checks the rifle and looks toward the next ridge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person inside shallow volcanic crater, rifle check, Marine helmets visible nearby, dark terrain ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low POV with one quick rifle check. Audio: breathing, rifle mechanism, distant shelling, wind. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Night Flares
scenes.description: Night arrives and illumination flares hang over the island.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks upward as one flare drifts above the position.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person night view from volcanic fighting position, bright illumination flare overhead, smoke and dark ridges, Marines low in cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt to one descending flare. Audio: night wind, distant combat, flare hiss, low breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Morning Ash
scenes.description: The next morning the squad advances through smoke and ash.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad through one low smoky corridor of terrain.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person morning movement through volcanic ridges, smoke haze, Marines in period gear ahead, no graphic imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward handheld movement through one terrain corridor. Audio: boots on ash, wind, gear movement, tired breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Water and Ammunition
scenes.description: A brief resupply pause gives the soldier water and fresh ammunition.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV accepts one canteen and ammunition bundle from another Marine.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hands receiving canteen and ammunition bundle behind volcanic ridge, helmets and gear nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff motion. Audio: gear clink, canteen movement, distant battle, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Suribachi in the Distance
scenes.description: The POV sees Mount Suribachi through thinning smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward Mount Suribachi.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person distant view of Mount Suribachi across dark volcanic terrain, smoke thinning, period Marines in foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan toward Suribachi. Audio: wind, distant guns, fabric and equipment movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Flag on the Mountain
scenes.description: Days later, a flag can be seen on Mount Suribachi from afar.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV raises binoculars toward a small distant U.S. flag on Suribachi.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view of Mount Suribachi with a small distant U.S. flag visible at summit, no recreation of famous close-up flag-raising pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and hold on distant summit. Audio: wind, distant combat, binocular handling, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Northward
scenes.description: The squad turns away from Suribachi toward the remaining island battle.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers binoculars and faces rough terrain to the north.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view north across rugged Iwo Jima terrain with smoke and ridges ahead, flag no longer in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn away from Suribachi toward northern terrain. Audio: wind, distant battle, boots shifting on ash, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Not Over
scenes.description: The episode ends with the squad advancing as fighting continues.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad forward over dark volcanic ground.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person following U.S. Marines north across Iwo Jima volcanic terrain, smoke ahead, late-day light, no victory celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward movement with squad. Audio: boots on ash, wind, distant battle, tired breathing. End with ongoing battlefield atmosphere. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous first-person Marine used as the viewer perspective; historically plausible 1945 Pacific uniform and equipment; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: USMC field uniform, M1 helmet with cover, web gear, gloves, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep sleeves, gloves, rifle, helmet shadow, volcanic dust and gear consistent. Avoid clear facial depiction.

atmosphereAssets.description: Gray Pacific water, landing craft, hazy outline of Iwo Jima and Mount Suribachi.

atmosphereAssets.title: Iwo Jima Beach and Southern Interior
atmosphereAssets.description: Black volcanic sand, steep terraces, smoke, low ridges and early inland positions.

atmosphereAssets.title: Airfield and Northern Advance Route
atmosphereAssets.description: Open volcanic terrain, rough berms, cratered ground and ridges leading north.
